playback.rigidTransform: translate(positionPx), rotate(rotationRad), scale(scale), draw PNG at -sourcePivotPx
playback.bakedTransform: Draw bakedPng at [0,0] with the canvas dimensions. Ignore TRS for that sample.
playback.socketRotation: Absolute direction of the projected Blender bone local +X axis. For an attachment authored at frame 1, use the change from its frame-1 rotation.
playback.accessoryVisibility: Skip drawOrder entries whose part accessory is disabled. Null accessory means always draw.

Yapraklar.bakeReason: The world-space leaf shader changes shading as the geometry moves.

Bacak_Sag.bakeReason: Knee skinning cannot be reproduced with one position, rotation and scale.
Bacak_Sag.bakedVisibility: Per-frame PNG has character occlusion baked in. Glasses and scarf are excluded from that mask.

Bacak_Sol.bakeReason: Knee skinning cannot be reproduced with one position, rotation and scale.
Bacak_Sol.bakedVisibility: Per-frame PNG has character occlusion baked in. Glasses and scarf are excluded from that mask.
